name: GitHub PR auto-healer & feedback loop
description: Monitors pull requests, detects CI test failures or review change requests, and automatically triggers an iterative repair revision loop.
exampleImplementation: A deterministic scheduled scanner checks all open factory PRs. If required CI checks fail or reviewers request changes, it flags the PR and requests an autonomous revision task to heal the branch.

schedule.label: Check frequency
schedule.help: How often to scan PRs for CI failures or review comments.

githubTokenSecret.label: GitHub token secret
githubTokenSecret.help: Name of a saved Agent Server secret.

branchPrefix.label: Branch prefix
branchPrefix.help: Branch prefix for factory PRs to heal.

maxRetries.label: Maximum auto-repair attempts
maxRetries.help: Number of times to attempt automatic fixing before escalating to human attention.

setup.message: Configure the repositories, token secret, branch prefix, and max retries.
